item.title: Build a Production-Ready Autonomous Expense Agent
item.author: Dudu Twizer
item.description: Upload an invoice and the agent reads it, classifies it, renames it, files it into the right Google Drive folder, and keeps an audit trail: the parts that break in production, solved.
